label: Pay button that looks at you
desc: A pay button with a pair of eyes that follow the pointer, look at the label on keyboard focus, and close into a confirmed check state when pressed.
use: checkout, billing, upgrade and connect pages

label: Folding subscribe
desc: A subscribe button that folds in on itself, becomes a paper plane that flies off, then settles into a Subscribed state with a reset.
use: newsletter sign-up, landing footer, blog posts

label: Hungry delete
desc: A mouth-shaped delete button that opens on hover or focus, swallows a file chip when activated and offers a timed undo.
use: file lists, publishing list, dashboard settings

label: Rolling publish
desc: A publish button whose cloud icon rolls up into a check while the label rolls slot-machine style from Publish to Published, with a progress fill.
use: publishing list, dashboard editor toolbar, deploy pages

label: Radial share
desc: A share button that fans out five targets (link, mail, chat, download, more) in an arc with staggered springs; arrow keys, Escape and menu semantics.
use: article and product pages, dashboard rows, publishing list
